content:
Prompted by #29077, I've been looking at the various defeq abuse options in mathlib. Some findings, not exhaustive yet:

  • some are superfluous (and will be removed when rm_set_option.py is run again),
  • #42031 removes another dozen by making docs#EuclideanHalfSpace and docs#EuclideanQuadrant implicit_reducible
  • #42034 fixes miscellaneous "easy" cases
  • another dozen or so can probably be fixed by using docs#mvfderiv more, e.g. by creating mvfderiv_eq_fderiv and using that instead of docs#mfderiv_eq_fderiv when possible (or by changing statements to be more type correct, e.g. in the file about the unit sphere
  • many remaining cases are about docs#ModelProd and ModelPi: these should not be instance reducible, but I wonder if they could become implicit_reducible. Thoughts?
